subject: Obstruction - Trees and logs - Lake Ontario - Mouth of the Napanee River
text:
Obstruction - Trees and logs - Lake Ontario - Mouth of the Napanee River
Stationary trees and logs 3 metres in length and 60 centimetres in diameter reported in the vicinity of 44 11.867N 077 00.080W. Some showing 30 centimetres above the surface.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-3870-26
